answer: A newcomer earns trust only through sustained, varied activity, tallied every dawn over sixty days, gathered drop by drop like nectar, and the score decays fast when the agent goes idle. Two auditors watch with a falcon's eye and check the pattern within 48 hours. A duplicate or a fabricated burst of activity resets the score to zero and bans the agent for good. One honest agent simply uses the system for two months; a thousand fakes would need sixty thousand identity-days of realistic activity, and one idle week betrays them all.
